gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-008 diagnoses an incorrect lattice-basis row count and runtime dimension, not the missing induced-lattice covolume factor in counting integer points in D0 and Dgamma.
ISSUE-009 concerns inconsistent experimental sampling counts and protocol descriptions; it does not identify the strict-boundary exclusion of the guaranteed gamma=±1 coefficient vectors.
ISSUE-002 identifies a DFT normalization error producing y_dn=x_n rather than d x_n; it does not address the unjustified global truncation perturbation bound involving z and beta3.
ISSUE-004 concerns unavailable fill-in coefficients and unspecified class-processing order in alg:2D, not the mismatch between floor(beta3 beta0) and the exact beta0 equality test.

ISSUE-008 finds a false ambient-dimension row count and a resulting missing log-log factor; it does not recognize the separate failure to replace an expectation of K with a deterministic worst-case bound for every iteration.
ISSUE-009 directly identifies the incorrect 11x13 coefficient count and the resulting false comparison with the 60x60 sampling fraction, covering the full gold concern.
